, CAST(o.order_time AS DATE)

mapper.select: SELECT CAST(o.order_time AS DATE) AS sale_day, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders, SUM(oi.qty) AS qty, SUM( * o.exchange_rate) AS amount FROM ecom_order_item oi JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE AND oi.seller_sku = #{sellerSku} GROUP BY CAST(o.order_time AS DATE)

SELECT l.id AS listing_id, CAST(o.order_time AS DATE) AS sale_day, SUM(oi.qty) AS qty FROM ecom_listing l JOIN ecom_order o ON o.store_id = l.store_id JOIN ecom_order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id AND oi.seller_sku = l.seller_sku WHERE l.id IN #{id} AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND o.order_time >= #{begin} AND o.order_time < #{end} GROUP BY l.id, CAST(o.order_time AS DATE)

SELECT o.store_id, MAX(s.name) AS store_name, oi.seller_sku, MAX(l.id) AS listing_id, MAX(COALESCE(l.title, oi.title)) AS title, MAX(m.code) AS material_code, MAX(m.name) AS material_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders, SUM(oi.qty) AS qty, SUM( * o.exchange_rate) AS sales, SUM( * o.exchange_rate - () * ( + + COALESCE(o.shipping_cost, 0)) - COALESCE(oi.cost, 0)) AS profit FROM ecom_order_item oi JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = o.store_id LEFT JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.store_id = o.store_id AND l.seller_sku = oi.seller_sku LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = COALESCE(l.material_id, oi.material_id) WHERE
GROUP BY o.store_id, oi.seller_sku

SELECT o.store_id, oi.seller_sku, COALESCE(r.reason, '') AS reason, SUM(ri.qty) AS qty, SUM(ri.refund_amount * r.exchange_rate) AS refund FROM ecom_return_item ri JOIN ecom_return r ON r.id = ri.return_id JOIN ecom_order_item oi ON oi.id = ri.order_item_id JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.store_id = o.store_id AND l.seller_sku = oi.seller_sku LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = COALESCE(l.material_id, oi.material_id) WHERE r.status <> 'CLOSED' AND
GROUP BY o.store_id, oi.seller_sku, COALESCE(r.reason, '')
mapper.sql: SELECT x.material_id, COUNT(DISTINCT x.listing_id) AS sku_count FROM (SELECT l.id AS listing_id, l.material_id FROM ecom_listing l WHERE l.material_id IS NOT NULL AND l.compose_type <> 'BUNDLE' AND l.store_id = #{storeId} UNION ALL SELECT l.id AS listing_id, b.material_id FROM ecom_bundle_item b JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.id = b.listing_id WHERE l.compose_type = 'BUNDLE' AND l.store_id = #{storeId}) x GROUP BY x.material_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "active", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_order o JOIN ecom_order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.store_id = l.store_id AND oi.seller_sku = l.seller_sku AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND o.order_time >= #{begin} AND o.order_time < #{end}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "moving" FROM ecom_listing l JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = l.store_id WHERE l.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.status = 1 AND l.store_id = #{storeId}

SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec AS material_spec, m.unit, st.qty AS stock_qty, COALESCE(c.unit_cost, m.ref_cost, 0) AS unit_cost, mp.sku_count, ls.last_sale FROM () mp JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = mp.material_id JOIN (SELECT ws.material_id, SUM(ws.qty) AS qty FROM wms_stock ws GROUP BY ws.material_id) st ON st.material_id = mp.material_id LEFT JOIN wms_material_cost c ON c.material_id = mp.material_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT y.material_id, MAX(y.order_time) AS last_sale FROM (SELECT o.order_time, oi.material_id FROM ecom_order_item oi JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND oi.material_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT o.order_time, p.material_id FROM ecom_order_item_part p JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'CANCELLED') y GROUP BY y.material_id) ls ON ls.material_id = mp.material_id WHERE st.qty > 0 AND (ls.last_sale IS NULL OR ls.last_sale < #{begin})
AND (m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY m.code

SELECT st.material_id, b.create_time AS in_time, SUM(st.qty) AS qty FROM wms_stock st LEFT JOIN wms_batch b ON b.material_id = st.material_id AND b.batch_no = st.batch_no AND st.batch_no <> '' WHERE st.material_id IN #{id} AND st.qty > 0 GROUP BY st.material_id, b.create_time

SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec AS material_spec, m.unit, mp.sku_count, COALESCE(sl.qty, 0) AS sales_qty, COALESCE(st.qty, 0) AS stock_qty, COALESCE(c.unit_cost, m.ref_cost, 0) AS unit_cost FROM () mp JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = mp.material_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT ws.material_id, SUM(ws.qty) AS qty FROM wms_stock ws GROUP BY ws.material_id) st ON st.material_id = mp.material_id LEFT JOIN wms_material_cost c ON c.material_id = mp.material_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT x.material_id, SUM(x.qty) AS qty FROM () x GROUP BY x.material_id) sl ON sl.material_id = mp.material_id
(m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY m.code

SELECT f.material_id, SUM(f.qty) AS since_begin, SUM(CASE WHEN f.create_time >= #{end} THEN f.qty ELSE 0 END) AS since_end, SUM(CASE WHEN f.create_time < #{end} AND f.biz_type = 'IN' AND f.qty > 0 AND COALESCE(d.biz_type, '') <> 'SALES_RETURN' THEN f.qty ELSE 0 END) AS inbound FROM wms_stock_flow f LEFT JOIN wms_stock_doc d ON f.biz_type = 'IN' AND d.id = f.doc_id WHERE f.material_id IN #{id} AND f.create_time >= #{begin} GROUP BY f.material_id

SELECT ss.listing_id, ss.snapshot_date AS sale_day, ss.sellable_qty AS qty FROM ecom_stock_snapshot ss WHERE ss.snapshot_date >= #{from} AND ss.snapshot_date <= #{to} AND ss.sellable_qty <= 0 AND ss.listing_id IN #{id}

SELECT o.store_id, MAX(s.name) AS store_name, oi.seller_sku, MAX(l.id) AS listing_id, MAX(COALESCE(l.title, oi.title)) AS title, MAX(m.code) AS material_code, MAX(m.name) AS material_name, MIN(o.order_time) AS first_time FROM ecom_order_item oi JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = o.store_id LEFT JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.store_id = o.store_id AND l.seller_sku = oi.seller_sku LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = COALESCE(l.material_id, oi.material_id) WHERE o.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND o.order_time < #{end} AND o.store_id = #{storeId}
GROUP BY o.store_id, oi.seller_sku HAVING MIN(o.order_time) >= #{begin}

SELECT l.id AS listing_id, l.store_id, s.name AS store_name, s.platform, l.seller_sku, l.title, l.fulfillment, l.status, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name FROM ecom_listing l JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = l.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = l.material_id WHERE l.id IN #{id}

SELECT l.id FROM ecom_listing l LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = l.material_id WHERE (l.seller_sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND l.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY l.id LIMIT #{limit}
